title: One table of all servers: status, resources, forecast

question.text:
Done: Checked A1-A6, D28, its guard test and #269 scope; no code changed.
Problem: A3 needs folder identities in browser data; D28 forbids inventory in /data/report. #269 allowed ingestion/export, not UI. Which boundary should apply?
Evidence: [#269](https://github.com/taskqorg/dashq/issues/269), [link](https://github.com/taskqorg/dashq/blob/596cd2ad0de258fe9ddd90fd774e643cb51b8f19/dashq.md)
1. Scoped typed inventory - + meets A2-A4 through /data/report; - authorized viewers see host, project and folder identities ★
2. Keep D28 exclusion - + keeps the current privacy boundary; - A2-A4 need owner/PM revision before implementation
To answer: `taskq answer 267.K` or comment `K` or the option text.

Done: Accepted 267.1; checked PilotQ contract, link handler and #375 dependency; no code changed.
Problem: A5 needs selected-server chat, but PilotQ /start ignores link payloads (builtins.rs:65-67). PilotQ #375 adds this flow and depends on #267, so live A5 is circular.
Evidence: [#375](https://github.com/taskqorg/pilotq/issues/375), [link](https://github.com/taskqorg/pilotq/blob/main/src/builtins.rs#L65)
1. Table first - + unblocks inventory and defines the link contract; - live A5 chat selection moves to PilotQ #375 ★
2. Keep A5 end-to-end - + proves selected-server chat here; - PM must resolve the #267/#375 dependency cycle before work
To answer: `taskq answer 267.K` or comment `K` or the option text.
